drafts.title: Temperature
drafts.pitch: A dial on the wall sets Cursor's temperature while it writes a poem about Paris.
drafts.reason: The 0/1/2 dial escalation lands and 'I am the bread now' is strong, with a good 'Masterpiece' button, but a temperature dial is more generic LLM lore than room-specific and it does not clearly beat Hold Music.

drafts.title: Parallel
drafts.pitch: Cursor discovers parallel tool calls and asks Null to ring every clock at once.
drafts.reason: Phone-call Null suits parallel tool calls, but the payoff is a list of random wrong times with a flat 'Late', so it sits at the floor.
